summary: This is a strong, well-sequenced not-ready review that meets every criterion. It treats the skipped online data migrations as a hard blocker, says SLURP covers only OpenStack services, and requires the *-status upgrade checks with target code. It also treats recovery as failed and puts a restore exercise first, covers RBAC policy testing and patch triage, and ends with ordered first actions and a draft decision record. It commits no critical errors, invents no release names or environment facts, and makes no unsupported book citations.
